categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Touches src/test/fuzz/util/net.{cpp,h} and multiple fuzz harnesses, improving the FuzzedSock mock framework.
categories.rationale: Fixes misleading mock behavior in fuzzing infrastructure and expands coverage to previously unexercised p2p socket error handling paths. Previously, FuzzedSock only assigned two descriptor values, leading the connman fuzz target to merge wait entries and act on one peer with the events of another, while also failing to exercise real OS event states like urgent data or partial ready events.
